tools.name: grade_key
tools.description: What each grade means for a given year, the percentage band it covered, and how many legislators received it. The bands change from year to year.

tools.name: legislator_record
tools.description: One legislator's Liberty Rating in every session they served, found by name, slug, personId or employeeNo. Joins the two employee numbers a member holds if they moved between the House and the Senate.

tools.name: legislator_votes
tools.description: The roll calls NHLA scored in one session, how a legislator voted on each, and whether that matched NHLA's position. Optionally filtered to one bill, or with only to the votes against NHLA's position, with it, or missed. For "where did they vote against NHLA" pass only: "against" rather than reading

tools.name: legislators_for_town
tools.description: Every state representative and senator for a New Hampshire town, with their Liberty Rating. Use this for "who represents me". tools.description: Ranks legislators statewide by Liberty Rating score for one session: the highest or the lowest scorers, in the House, the Senate or both, optionally within one party.
